feature_queries.name: paper_base5
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.Paper_ID,
  t.date,
  DATE_DIFF('day', p.Submission_Date, t.date) AS paper_age_days,
  EXTRACT(year FROM t.date) AS asof_year,
  EXTRACT(month FROM t.date) AS asof_month,
  p.Primary_Category_ID AS primary_cat_id,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.Title,'')) AS title_len,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.Abstract,'')) AS abstract_len
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN papers p ON p.Paper_ID = t.Paper_ID

feature_queries.name: citation_hist5
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS total_cites_before,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS cites_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '180 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS cites_180d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '365 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS cites_365d,
    MAX(DATE_DIFF('day', c.Submission_Date, t.date)) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS days_since_first_cite,
    MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', c.Submission_Date, t.date)) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS days_since_most_recent_cite
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN citations c
    ON c.References_Paper_ID = t.Paper_ID
  GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date
)
SELECT
  b.*,
  CASE WHEN b.total_cites_before>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_any_cite_before,
  COALESCE(CAST(b.cites_180d AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(b.total_cites_before AS DOUBLE),0),0) AS frac_cites_last_180d,
  COALESCE(CAST(b.cites_30d AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(b.cites_180d AS DOUBLE),0),0) AS frac_cites_30_over_180
FROM base b

feature_queries.name: citation_norm5
feature_queries.sql:
WITH age AS (
  SELECT t.Paper_ID, t.date, DATE_DIFF('day', p.Submission_Date, t.date) AS paper_age_days
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN papers p ON p.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID
), cites AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS total_cites_before,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '180 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS cites_180d
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN citations c
    ON c.References_Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID
  GROUP BY t.Paper_ID,t.date
)
SELECT
  a.Paper_ID, a.date,
  COALESCE(CAST(c.total_cites_before AS DOUBLE) / (a.paper_age_days + 1),0) AS cites_per_day_life,
  COALESCE(CAST(c.cites_180d AS DOUBLE) / LEAST(a.paper_age_days + 1,180),0) AS cites_per_day_last180cap
FROM age a
LEFT JOIN cites c
  ON c.Paper_ID=a.Paper_ID AND c.date=a.date

feature_queries.name: authors_agg39
feature_queries.sql:
WITH author_hist AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    pa.Author_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pa2.Paper_ID) AS author_prev_papers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c2.Paper_ID) AS author_prev_citations
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN paperAuthors pa
    ON pa.Paper_ID = t.Paper_ID
   AND pa.Submission_Date < t.date
  LEFT JOIN paperAuthors pa2
    ON pa2.Author_ID = pa.Author_ID
   AND pa2.Submission_Date < t.date
  LEFT JOIN citations c2
    ON c2.References_Paper_ID = pa2.Paper_ID
   AND c2.Submission_Date < t.date
  GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date, pa.Author_ID
)
SELECT
  Paper_ID,
  date,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT Author_ID),0) AS n_authors,
  COALESCE(AVG(author_prev_papers),0) AS avg_author_prev_papers,
  COALESCE(AVG(author_prev_citations),0) AS avg_author_prev_citations
FROM author_hist
GROUP BY Paper_ID, date

feature_queries.name: author_velocity9
feature_queries.sql:
WITH paper_auth AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    pa.Author_ID
  FROM eval_table t
  JOIN paperAuthors pa
    ON pa.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID
   AND pa.Submission_Date < t.date
), author_papers AS (
  SELECT
    pa0.Paper_ID, pa0.date, pa0.Author_ID,
    pa1.Paper_ID AS author_paper_id
  FROM paper_auth pa0
  JOIN paperAuthors pa1
    ON pa1.Author_ID = pa0.Author_ID
   AND pa1.Submission_Date < pa0.date
), author_cites AS (
  SELECT
    ap.Paper_ID, ap.date, ap.Author_ID,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= ap.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.Submission_Date < ap.date) AS author_cites_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= ap.date - INTERVAL '180 days' AND c.Submission_Date < ap.date) AS author_cites_180d
  FROM author_papers ap
  LEFT JOIN citations c
    ON c.References_Paper_ID = ap.author_paper_id
   AND c.Submission_Date < ap.date
  GROUP BY ap.Paper_ID, ap.date, ap.Author_ID
)
SELECT
  t.Paper_ID, t.date,
  COALESCE(AVG(author_cites_30d),0) AS avg_author_cites_30d,
  COALESCE(MAX(author_cites_30d),0) AS max_author_cites_30d,
  COALESCE(AVG(author_cites_180d),0) AS avg_author_cites_180d,
  COALESCE(MAX(author_cites_180d),0) AS max_author_cites_180d
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN author_cites ac
  ON ac.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID AND ac.date=t.date
GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date

feature_queries.name: out_refs15
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.Paper_ID,
  t.date,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS n_refs_made_before,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.References_Paper_ID) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS n_unique_refs_made_before,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS n_refs_made_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.Submission_Date >= t.date - INTERVAL '180 days' AND c.Submission_Date < t.date) AS n_refs_made_180d
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN citations c
  ON c.Paper_ID = t.Paper_ID
GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date

feature_queries.name: reference_quality5
feature_queries.sql:
WITH refs AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    c.References_Paper_ID AS ref_paper_id
  FROM eval_table t
  JOIN citations c
    ON c.Paper_ID = t.Paper_ID
   AND c.Submission_Date < t.date
), ref_citedness AS (
  SELECT
    r.Paper_ID, r.date, r.ref_paper_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ref_incoming_cites_before
  FROM refs r
  JOIN citations ci
    ON ci.References_Paper_ID = r.ref_paper_id
   AND ci.Submission_Date < r.date
  GROUP BY r.Paper_ID, r.date, r.ref_paper_id
)
SELECT
  t.Paper_ID,
  t.date,
  COALESCE(AVG(ref_incoming_cites_before),0) AS avg_ref_cites_before,
  COALESCE(MAX(ref_incoming_cites_before),0) AS max_ref_cites_before,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ref_incoming_cites_before>=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS n_refs_to_10p_cited
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN ref_citedness rc
  ON rc.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID AND rc.date=t.date
GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date

feature_queries.name: ref_velocity41
feature_queries.sql:
WITH refs AS (
  SELECT
    t.Paper_ID, t.date,
    c.References_Paper_ID AS ref_paper_id
  FROM eval_table t
  JOIN citations c
    ON c.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID
   AND c.Submission_Date < t.date
), ref_vel AS (
  SELECT
    r.Paper_ID, r.date, r.ref_paper_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.Submission_Date >= r.date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ci.Submission_Date < r.date) AS ref_cites_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.Submission_Date >= r.date - INTERVAL '180 days' AND ci.Submission_Date < r.date) AS ref_cites_180d
  FROM refs r
  LEFT JOIN citations ci
    ON ci.References_Paper_ID = r.ref_paper_id
   AND ci.Submission_Date < r.date
  GROUP BY r.Paper_ID, r.date, r.ref_paper_id
)
SELECT
  t.Paper_ID, t.date,
  COALESCE(AVG(ref_cites_30d),0) AS avg_ref_cites_30d,
  COALESCE(AVG(ref_cites_180d),0) AS avg_ref_cites_180d
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN ref_vel rv
  ON rv.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID AND rv.date=t.date
GROUP BY t.Paper_ID, t.date

feature_queries.name: cat_cite_intensity5
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT t.Paper_ID, t.date, p.Primary_Category_ID AS cat_id
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN papers p ON p.Paper_ID=t.Paper_ID
), cat_papers AS (
  SELECT
    b.Paper_ID, b.date, b.cat_id,
    p2.Paper_ID AS cat_paper_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN papers p2
    ON p2.Primary_Category_ID=b.cat_id
   AND p2.Submission_Date < b.date
), cat_incoming AS (
  SELECT
    cp.Paper_ID, cp.date, cp.cat_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cat_incoming_cites_before
  FROM cat_papers cp
  JOIN citations c
    ON c.References_Paper_ID = cp.cat_paper_id
   AND c.Submission_Date < cp.date
  GROUP BY cp.Paper_ID, cp.date, cp.cat_id
)
SELECT
  b.Paper_ID, b.date,
  COALESCE(ci.cat_incoming_cites_before,0) AS cat_incoming_cites_before,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM papers p3
     WHERE p3.Primary_Category_ID=b.cat_id
       AND p3.Submission_Date < b.date) AS cat_prev_papers,
  COALESCE(CAST(ci.cat_incoming_cites_before AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM papers p3
     WHERE p3.Primary_Category_ID=b.cat_id
       AND p3.Submission_Date < b.date),0),0) AS cat_cites_per_prior_paper
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN cat_incoming ci
  ON ci.Paper_ID=b.Paper_ID AND ci.date=b.date
